records.Name: Outsider
records.Description:
This is my story.
I’ve always pictured this moment: slipping into a sharp suit, perfecting my tie, spritzing cologne…
But is it wise to dress like a dinner party guest when my world’s on fire?
As the flames draw near, I realize—our differences vanish in the heat.
records.Author: 阿宇

records.Name: Count Sheep
records.Description:
This is a story about insomnia.
In a city that never sleeps, I crave deep, undisturbed slumber.
Mad love for those sheep trying to help me drift off.
Tonight, I wish you sweet dreams.
records.Author: 透纳

records.Name: Across the Window Pane
records.Description:
This is a story about life at dizzying heights.
A privileged girl meets a window cleaner, and sparks fly.
As they navigate their worlds, they fall hard for each other.
Through every challenge, their love lifts them higher.
records.Author: Helen

records.Name: Tianyuan Town
records.Description: Global celebrity, or hardened criminal? Uncover a conspiracy no one could have predicted.

records.Name: BEASTY
records.Description: Controlled in the name of “love”, a child star named Lele constantly walks the line between fiction and reality, losing all right to choose.
records.Author: 牙牙 阿德 栗栗 rimi Nada

records.Name: Hospland
records.Description: While it’s billed as a paradise, the child within knows nothing but suffering. Her father ultimately chooses to say goodbye, leaving her to drift into a long, beautiful dream.
records.Author: 大崽 宵木 文狸

records.Name: Beyond the Highway
records.Description: Birds soar across the sky, and we will be there to witness it.
records.Author: 左奇
